Container.Name: Facet
Container.Overview:
Facet is a self-hosted personal profile platform. Create multiple views of your professional profile for different audiences (recruiters, conferences, clients) and own all of your data.
Each view is a curated slice of your full profile: a recruiter sees roles and references, a conference organizer sees talks and bio, a client sees portfolio and rates. You decide what each audience sees and they only see what you've shared.
Default password: `changeme123` (you will be prompted to change it on first login).
Features: - Multiple profile views per person - OAuth login via Google or GitHub (optional) - Optional AI assist via OpenAI, Anthropic, or local Ollama - All data stays on your server - Single Docker container, embedded SQLite database
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: personal profile portfolio resume cv recruiter conference client self-hosted

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Container Port: 8080 (Caddy reverse proxy fronts the SvelteKit UI and PocketBase API).

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Path to app data (SQLite database and configuration). Include this in backups.

Config.Name: Uploads Storage
Config.Description: Path to uploaded images and files.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public URL for Facet (e.g. http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:8080). Used for OAuth callbacks and share links.

Config.Name: Admin Emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated email allowlist for OAuth login. Leave empty to allow any email.

Config.Name: Behind Proxy
Config.Description: Set to true if running behind a reverse proxy (NPMplus, Traefik, Cloudflare Tunnel).

Config.Name: OAuth - Google - Client ID
Config.Description: Client ID for Sign in with Google. Redirect URI: YOUR_URL/api/oauth2-redirect

Config.Name: OAuth - Google - Client Secret
Config.Description: Client secret from Google Cloud Console.

Config.Name: OAuth - GitHub - Client ID
Config.Description: Client ID for Sign in with GitHub. Redirect URI: YOUR_URL/api/oauth2-redirect

Config.Name: OAuth - GitHub - Client Secret
Config.Description: Client secret from GitHub OAuth Apps.

Config.Name: AI - Ollama - URL
Config.Description: URL for local Ollama instance (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:11434).

Config.Name: Admin UI Enabled
Config.Description: Enable PocketBase admin UI at /_/ for debugging. Leave false in production.
